data.status: tentatively targeting a July 2026 opening

The concept is slated to open beside Marblehead House of Pizza at 1 Atlantic Ave in Marblehead, tentatively targeting July 2026, pending final preparations and hiring. data.status: will break ground this fall
data.short_description: The Laureate is a new boutique hotel being developed by Tina McCarthy, Chad Ingram, and Rob Johnston, incorporating the historic Farmers and Merchants Bank Building into an 84-room, four-story structure with suites, extended-stay residences, a lobby bar, and a garden courtyard. The project will break ground this fall in downtown Aiken, SC at 167 Laurens St., combining a historic renovation of the bank building with a new build where the drive-thru teller currently stands. The historic portion will house a restaurant and bar, meeting rooms, fitness space, and possibly a small spa, with the restaurant's name and menu still being finalized.
